cases.title: Grade mismatch box (Set my own 1 in 100, 18.000 / 17.900 over 20 m) shows Cancel; Cancel closes it, prints the cancelled line and draws nothing
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 30 Oct 2026 from the BUG-857 fix report, the C-78 finalizer report and GradeMismatchDialog.xaml / .xaml.cs and CdCommand.cs at 7c6af57b; not compared with a run.
cases.expected: CD 150000,-66000 to 170000,-66000, "I know one end" OFF, Set my own 100, levels 18.000 / 17.900, Start Pipe: the window "Creative Engineering | Grade mismatch" opens; its text holds "Use 1 IN 200", "Keep 1 IN 100", "places no pipe" and a "Cancel" button. Pressing Cancel closes it; the command line says "Grade mismatch box cancelled - no pipe placed."; the Civil log says "CD: Grade mismatch box cancelled; no pipe placed"; the drawing gains NO object. A reset pipe follows and is recorded. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit tests pin the rule and the switch; only the live CD command shows that the real box's Cancel returns before anything is drawn.
not_automated: Esc and the X are not driven (one real Esc to a modal CE box through v3 esc-key is unproven; the X is a title-bar click). They share the same code path as Cancel (EscapeCommand = CancelCommand with the switch ON; WhenDismissed = Cancel).
Enter (keeps the typed grade and draws) is not driven: Keep is not on the press list.
The look of the box (three buttons not clipped at 100, 125 and 150 per cent) is the Codex look of the finalizer report item (a).
